events.factual_description: Lincoln Center Presents and Unsound New York present Hania Rani Presents Non-Fiction on Friday, October 23, 2026 at 19:30 in Wu Tsai Theater, David Geffen Hall, 10 Lincoln Center Plaza, New York. The program is the final night of Unsound New York's 2026 Lincoln Center residency. Księżyc opens with The Eternal Circle, a rare concert built around the 30th anniversary of the Polish group's self-titled 1996 debut; Lincoln Center notes that additional guests are still to be announced. Rani then performs Non-Fiction: Piano Concerto in Four Movements with the Warsaw-based 45-piece Sinfonia Varsovia and guests Valentina Magaletti on drums and Jack Wyllie on saxophone. Lincoln Center describes this as Rani's David Geffen Hall debut. The event uses Lincoln Center's Choose-What-You-Pay model; member presale began September 2 and general on-sale is scheduled for September 9, 2026, so no stable event-specific public purchase destination or numeric face-value range is recorded yet.

en.why_it_matters: This is really two unusually coherent listening threads in one night. Księżyc revisits its cult 1996 debut after thirty years, then Rani takes her first piano concerto into a full orchestral setting with Sinfonia Varsovia while Magaletti and Wyllie keep the score connected to experimental and improvisational language. The attraction is the collision of memory, orchestral scale and unstable texture, not simply a well-known pianist in a major hall.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is viable on October 23, actively make room for David Geffen Hall and let this anchor the evening. From the DMV, pair it with another strong New York reason or an overnight rather than turn the corridor into a rushed same-day run.

es.why_it_matters: En realidad son dos hilos de escucha muy bien amarrados en una sola noche. Księżyc vuelve a su disco de culto de 1996 treinta años después y, enseguida, Rani lleva su primer concierto para piano a una escala plenamente orquestal con Sinfonia Varsovia, mientras Magaletti y Wyllie mantienen la obra conectada con el lenguaje experimental y la improvisación. Lo interesante es el choque entre memoria, masa orquestal y textura inestable, no simplemente ver a una pianista conocida en una sala importante.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York es viable el 23 de octubre, sí le haría espacio activamente a David Geffen Hall y dejaría que esta función ancle la noche. Desde el DMV la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir o con una noche en la ciudad, en vez de convertir el corredor en una ida y vuelta apretada el mismo día.
